provenance_note: The README calls data/ a 'synthetic dataset with some of the key variables', but the inputs used here (orange_book.dta, drug_with_atpcode.dta, paragraph_iv_updated2021.dta: FDA Orange Book, KEGG ATC codes, FDA Paragraph IV list) are public sources shipped in full, and rebuilding the panel from them reproduces every row count in the authors' log and the coefficient to 7 digits. 'Synthetic' in the README appears to mean 'assembled' (the README's own heading is 'Synthesized dataset'); proprietary Paragraph IV Report variables are set to missing in other files but are not used by this specification. Lead to confirm; flip to 'synthetic' if the literal README rule is preferred.
code_line: 74 (regression); 27-70 (panel construction); inputs built by supplementary_files.do lines 275-286, 292-316, 323-343, 349-405
outcome_label: Number of the firm's active NDAs in the ATC-3 class in year t (count, level)
notes: Unit of observation: firm (applicant_id) x ATC-3 class x year, 1990-2016, 7,733 rows, 557 firm-ATC3 cells, 416 firms; reghdfe drops 1,350 singletons (N 6,383, 362 firms, 103 ATC-3 classes). FE: firm (applicant_id; a GROUP FE coarser than the firm-ATC3 cell) + year x ATC-3 class (calendar time x time-invariant class), so id_var = applicant_id and xt_vars = atc_level3_chr (ATC-3 code as a string so that expand_xt builds class dummies for CSA). Because several ATC-3 rows share a firm-year, run_spec/CSA treat the data as repeated cross-sections assigned to firms (allowed by PROTOCOL Sec. 2). Treatment: piv_sub_d = 1[year >= piv_yr], piv_yr = year of the firm's first Paragraph IV challenge (earliest across its drugs, from FDA Paragraph IV submission dates), constant within firm (verified) and attached to the ATC-3 class(es) of the earliest-challenged drug(s); unattacked ATC-3 classes of attacked firms are dropped; piv_yr < 2004 or > 2015 dropped; firms never challenged = never treated (gvar NA -> Inf). Absorbing, no switch-off (verified). Cohorts (firm-ATC3 cells): 2004 (37), 2005 (25), 2006 (17), 2007 (13), 2008 (26), 2009 (11), 2010 (8), 2011 (12), 2012 (12), 2013 (10), 2014 (6), 2015 (12) = 189 treated cells, 368 never-treated cells (62.3% of rows); 12 treated cells (0.9% of rows) are observed only from piv_yr onwards (always treated in-sample). Panel unbalanced (cells start at the firm's first approved NDA in the class). Clustering: authors use two-way (firm, ATC-3); run_spec supports one cluster variable, so cluster = firm (published two-way SE 0.0251765; firm-only fixest SE 0.0242513). Sample: all 7,733 rows are kept (fixest fixef.rm='none'; singletons do not change the point estimate), so y_sd_regsample is 0.3642 rather than the 0.3384 of the authors' 6,383-row sample. Reference (not published): firm x ATC-3 cell FE instead of firm FE gives -0.0708019 (0.0250569). Headline Tables 3, 4 and 5 col 1 add drug-age FE (i.age) and are excluded as near-misses per the screening record; Table 5 col 2 is the only eligible specification.
